Mayawati Appoints Nephew Ishan Anand as BSP National Coordinator

Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has appointed her younger nephew, Ishan Anand, as the party's National Coordinator. This appointment was reported across several outlets, with one noting that this move involved handing a key party post to one nephew while snubbing another. Ishan Anand was seen with BSP chief Mayawati during an all-India review meeting of the party.
